Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(
    gblRecordSelectedProject,
    LookUp(
        Projects,
        ThisRecord.Project = gblRecordSelectedProject.Project
    )
);
Set(
    gblCurrentUser,
    Patch(
        gblCurrentUser,
        {
            CanEditSelectedProject: And(
                DataSourceInfo(
                    Projects,
                    DataSourceInfo.CreatePermission
                ),
                Coalesce(
                    RecordInfo(
                        gblRecordSelectedProject,
                        RecordInfo.EditPermission
                    ),
                    false
                )
            )
        }
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    colMilestonesFormValidation,
    Blank()
);
UpdateContext(
    {
        locSelectedStartClusterNo: Switch(
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Start Cluster',
                'Cluster States'.Greenfield
            ),
            'Cluster States'.Greenfield,
            0,
            'Cluster States'.'Cluster 1',
            1,
            'Cluster States'.'Cluster 2',
            2,
            'Cluster States'.'Cluster 3',
            3,
            'Cluster States'.'Cluster 4',
            4,
            'Cluster States'.'Cluster 5',
            5,
            'Cluster States'.'Cluster 6',
            6,
            0
        )
    }
);
UpdateContext(
    {
        locRequiredfieldHeight: 56,
        locRecordMilestoneNames: With(
            {
                milestoneProjectStates: Filter(
                    'Project States',
                    Order > 0,
                    'Is Visible On Checklist'
                )
            },
            ShowColumns(
                SortByColumns(
                    AddColumns(
                        milestoneProjectStates,
                        strOrder,
                        Text(Order)
                    ),
                    "strOrder",
                    SortOrder.Ascending
                ),
                'Cluster Description'
            )
        ),
        locIsVisiblePopUpConfirmationDialog: false,
        locIsVisibleIndividualVolumeWarning : false,
        //locIsVisiblePopUpConfirmationDialogDesc: Blank(),
        locLongOperationProcessingDialog: false,
        locLongOperationProcessingDialogText: "",
        locLeaveMilestonesConfirmationDialog: false,
        locGeneralMilestonesInformationDialog: false,
        locGeneralMilestonesInformationDialogTitle: "",
        locGeneralMilestonesInformationDialogText: "",
        locRecalculationFormulaVisibility: false,
        locNeedPlantCostsRecalculation: false,
        locProjectCluster1Date: If(
            locSelectedStartClusterNo = 1 && IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'1-Feasibility studies',
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'
            ),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'1-Feasibility studies'
        ),
        locProjectCluster2Date: If(
            locSelectedStartClusterNo = 2 && IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'2-Project development started',
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'
            ),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'2-Project development started'
        ),
        locProjectCluster3Date: If(
            locSelectedStartClusterNo = 3 && IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'3-Application submitted',
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'
            ),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'3-Application submitted'
        ),
        locProjectCluster4Date: If(
            locSelectedStartClusterNo = 4 && IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'4-Legally binding permits',
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'
            ),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'4-Legally binding permits'
        ),
        locProjectCluster5Date: If(
            locSelectedStartClusterNo = 5 && IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'5-Construction',
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'
            ),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'5-Construction'
        ),
        locProjectCluster6Date: If(
            locSelectedStartClusterNo = 6 && IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Acquisition date'
            ),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)'
        ),
        locProjectFidDate: gblRecordSelectedProject.'Final Investment Decision',
        locProjectEndDate: gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date',
        locSalesStartDate: gblRecordSelectedProject.'Sales Start Date',
        locSalesEndDate: gblRecordSelectedProject.'Sales completed',
        locShareOfFarmdown: Coalesce(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Share of Farmdown',
            50
        ),
        locShareOfFarmdownStandard: If(
            Coalesce(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is Standard Share of Farmdown?',
                'Is Standard Share of Farmdown? (Projects)'.Yes
            ) = 'Is Standard Share of Farmdown? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        )
    }
);
Select(btn_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_Buttons_Reset_Validation);
Concurrent(
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_StartDate),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster5),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster6),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Sales_StartDate),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Sales_CompletionDate),
    Reset(dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_EndDate),
    Reset(txt_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Years),
    Reset(txt_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Share_of_Farmdown)
);
//Select(btn_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_Buttons_Reset);
UpdateContext(
    {
        locCluster2DateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is 2-Project development Standard Assumption ?' = 'Is 2-Project development Standard Assumption ? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locCluster3DateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is 3-Application submitted Standard Assumption?' = 'Is 3-Application submitted Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locCluster4DateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is 4-Legally binding permits Standard Assumption?' = 'Is 4-Legally binding permits Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locFidDateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is Final Investment Decision Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Final Investment Decision Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locCluster5DateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is 5-Construction Standard Assumption?' = 'Is 5-Construction Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locCluster6DateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is Operations StartDate (COD) Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Operations StartDate (COD) Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locSalesStartDateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is Sales StartDate Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Sales StartDate Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locSalesCompletionDateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is Sales CompletionDate Standard Assumption?' = 'Is Sales CompletionDate Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        ),
        locProjectEndDateStandardAssumption: If(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Is End Date Standard Assumption?' = 'Is End Date Standard Assumption? (Projects)'.Yes,
            true,
            false
        )
    }
);

UpdateContext(
    {
        locRequiredfieldHeight: 56,
        locIsVisiblePopUpConfirmationDialog: false,
        locIsVisibleIndividualVolumeWarning : false,
       // locIsVisiblePopUpConfirmationDialogDesc: Blank(),
        locLongOperationProcessingDialog: false,
        locLongOperationProcessingDialogText: Blank(),
        locLeaveMilestonesConfirmationDialog: false,
        locGeneralMilestonesInformationDialog: false,
        locGeneralMilestonesInformationDialogTitle: Blank(),
        locGeneralMilestonesInformationDialogText: Blank(),
        locRecalculationFormulaVisibility: false,
        locNeedPlantCostsRecalculation: false,
        locProjectCluster1Date: Blank(),
        locProjectCluster2Date: Blank(),
        locProjectCluster3Date:Blank(),
        locProjectCluster4Date: Blank(),
        locProjectCluster5Date: Blank(),
        locProjectCluster6Date: Blank(),
        locProjectFidDate: Blank(),
        locProjectEndDate: Blank(),
        locSalesStartDate: Blank(),
        locSalesEndDate: Blank()
    }
);
Select(btn_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_Buttons_Reset);
Clear(colMilestonesFormValidation);

Rules.InvariantScript:
Refresh('Project Revenues');
Concurrent(
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locGeneralDataIsSavingDialogVisible: true,
            locGeneralDataSavingDialogText: $"The project is being saved, please wait.."
        }
    ),
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locAreaWithRegion: With(
                {
                    _area: Trim(
                        Coalesce(
                            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Area/State/Province'.Name,
                            ""
                        )
                    )
                },
                Switch(
                    _area,
                    "Lazio",
                    "Italy_Centre - South",
                    "Lombardia",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Emilia Romagna",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Sicilia",
                    "Italy_Sicily",
                    "Valle d’Aosta",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Veneto",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Friuli Venezia Giulia",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Puglia",
                    "Italy_South",
                    "Marche",
                    "Italy_Centre - North",
                    "Molise",
                    "Italy_South",
                    "Calabria",
                    "Italy_Calabria",
                    "Abruzzo",
                    "Italy_Centre - South",
                    "Piemonte",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Sardegna",
                    "Italy_Sardinia",
                    "Toscana",
                    "Italy_Centre - North",
                    "Trentino Alto Adige",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Campania",
                    "Italy_Centre - South",
                    "Liguria",
                    "Italy_North",
                    "Basilicata",
                    "Italy_South",
                    "Umbria",
                    "Italy_Centre - South",
                    Blank()
                )
            )
        }
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    colProcessingSteps,
    Blank()
);
IfError(
    Set(
        gblRecordSelectedProject,
        Patch(
            Projects,
            gblRecordSelectedProject,
            {
                /*'Project Start Date': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_StartDate.SelectedDate,
                '1-Feasibility studies': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1.SelectedDate,
                '2-Project development started': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2.SelectedDate,
                '3-Application submitted': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3.SelectedDate,
                '4-Legally binding permits': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4.SelectedDate,*/
                'Project Start Date': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 1,
                    Blank(),
                    dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_StartDate.SelectedDate
                ),
                '1-Feasibility studies': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 2,
                    Blank(),
                    dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster1.SelectedDate
                ),
                '2-Project development started': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 3,
                    Blank(),
                    dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster2.SelectedDate
                ),
                '3-Application submitted': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 4,
                    Blank(),
                    dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster3.SelectedDate
                ),
                '4-Legally binding permits': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 5,
                    Blank(),
                    dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster4.SelectedDate
                ),
                'Final Investment Decision': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_FiD.SelectedDate,
                '5-Construction': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster5.SelectedDate,
                'Operations start date (COD)': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Cluster6.SelectedDate,
                'End Date': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_EndDate.SelectedDate,
                'Sales Start Date': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Sales_StartDate.SelectedDate,
                'Sales completed': dtp_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Sales_CompletionDate.SelectedDate,
                'Is 2-Project development Standard Assumption ?': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 3,
                    false,
                    locCluster2DateStandardAssumption
                ),
                'Is 3-Application submitted Standard Assumption?': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 4,
                    false,
                    locCluster3DateStandardAssumption
                ),
                'Is 4-Legally binding permits Standard Assumption?': If(
                    locSelectedStartClusterNo >= 5,
                    false,
                    locCluster4DateStandardAssumption
                ),
                /*'Is 2-Project development Standard Assumption ?': locCluster2DateStandardAssumption,
                'Is 3-Application submitted Standard Assumption?': locCluster3DateStandardAssumption,
                'Is 4-Legally binding permits Standard Assumption?': locCluster4DateStandardAssumption,*/
                'Is Final Investment Decision Standard Assumption?': locFidDateStandardAssumption,
                'Is 5-Construction Standard Assumption?': locCluster5DateStandardAssumption,
                'Is Operations StartDate (COD) Standard Assumption?': locCluster6DateStandardAssumption,
                'Operational Lifetime': $"{txt_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Years.Value} {txt_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Months.Value}",
                'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)': gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.'Business Unit',
                'Is Sales StartDate Standard Assumption?': locSalesStartDateStandardAssumption,
                'Is Sales CompletionDate Standard Assumption?': locSalesCompletionDateStandardAssumption,
                'Is End Date Standard Assumption?': locProjectEndDateStandardAssumption,
                'Share of Farmdown': Value(txt_Milestones_DisplayProject_Body_General_Content_Share_of_Farmdown.Value),
                'Is Standard Share of Farmdown?': locShareOfFarmdownStandard
            }
        )
    );
    Collect(
        colProcessingSteps,
        "Project data was saved/updated successfully."
    );
    Set(
        gblRecordSelectedProject,
        LookUp(
            Projects,
            ThisRecord.Project = gblRecordSelectedProject.Project
        )
    );
    UpdateIf(
        colMilestonesFormValidation,
        true,
        {
            Valid: true,
            Dirty: false
        }
    );
    If(
        locNeedPlantCostsRecalculation,
        ClearCollect(
            colProjectGeneratorsUpdated,
            Patch(
                GeneratorTypeInProjects,
                colProjectGenerators
            )
        );
        Set(
            gblRecordSelectedProject,
            Patch(
                Projects,
                gblRecordSelectedProject,
                {
                    'Plant WTG Cost [EUR]': Sum(
                        colProjectGenerators,
                        'Generators Cost'
                    )
                }
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colProcessingSteps,
            $"Plant WTG Cost (WTG's: {CountIf(
                colProjectGeneratorsUpdated,
                true
            )}), was recalculated and updated successfully."
        );
    );
    /*
    UpdateContext(
        {
            locActiveProjectFabricRecalculateJob: Patch(
                'Fabric Sync Jobs',
                Defaults('Fabric Sync Jobs'),
                {
                    Name: " ",
                    'Regarding Object': gblRecordSelectedProject,
                    'Job Status': 'Job States'.Dirty,
                    'Job Type': LookUp(
                        'Fabric Job Types',
                        Name = "Project Milestones changed"
                    )
                }
            )
        }
    );
    If(
        locActiveProjectFabricRecalculateJob.'Job Status' = 'Job States'.Dirty,
        Notify(
            'ForaProjecttriggerFabricDEVEX/CAPEXrecalculation'.Run(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.Project,
                locActiveProjectFabricRecalculateJob.'Fabric Sync Job'
            ).message
        )
    );*/Notify(
        Concat(
            colProcessingSteps,
            $"{Value} {Char(10)}"
        ),
        NotificationType.Success,
        gblAppConstants.DefNotifyTimeoutMilliseconds
    );
    If(
        And(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name in [
                "Draft",
                "Cluster 1"
            ],
            CountRows(
                Filter(
                    'Project Revenues',
                    Project.Project = gblRecordSelectedProject.Project
                )
            ) = 0
        ),
        With(
            {
                recCountry: gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name,
                recTechnologyType: gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology,
                recTechnologyTypeText: Lower(Text(gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology)),
                recCountryAssumptions: Filter(
                    'Assumptions Revenues SQL',
                    country = gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name
                ),
                recRevenueTypeRecordForCountry: LookUp(
                    'Assumptions Revenues SQL',
                    And(
                        country = gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name,
                        valuetype = "revenuetype"
                    )
                ),
                recProjectFIDDate: gblRecordSelectedProject.'Final Investment Decision',
                recFIDThresholdDate: Date(
                    2026,
                    12,
                    31
                )
            },
            With(
                {
                    recCountryTechnologyAssumptionExist: If(
                        recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                        Not(IsBlank(recRevenueTypeRecordForCountry.pv)),
                        recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                        Not(IsBlank(recRevenueTypeRecordForCountry.wind)),
                        false
                    ),
                    recCategories: ShowColumns(
                        recCountryAssumptions,
                        category
                    ),
                    recRevenueType: Switch(
                        true,
                        recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                        If(
                            recRevenueTypeRecordForCountry.pv = "fit",
                            'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                            recRevenueTypeRecordForCountry.pv = "ppa",
                            'Revenue Labels'.PPA,
                            Blank()
                        ),
                        recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                        If(
                            recRevenueTypeRecordForCountry.pv = "fit",
                            'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                            recRevenueTypeRecordForCountry.pv = "ppa",
                            'Revenue Labels'.PPA,
                            Blank()
                        ),
                        Blank()
                    ),
                    recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords: Filter(
                        recCountryAssumptions,
                        valuetype = "change_revenuetype"
                    )
                },
                Set(
                    ab,
                    Not(IsBlank(recRevenueType))
                );
                If(
                    Not(IsBlank(recRevenueType)),
                    With(
                        {
                            recReveneLabelType: recRevenueType,
                            recReveneDescription: With(
                                {
                                    recSubContractTypeDependingOnReferenceDate: If(
                                        Text(
                                            Switch(
                                                recTechnologyType,
                                                Technology.Wind,
                                                LookUp(
                                                    recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                                    category = "issubcontract_type_depending_on_reference_date"
                                                ).wind,
                                                Technology.PV,
                                                LookUp(
                                                    recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                                    category = "issubcontract_type_depending_on_reference_date"
                                                ).pv,
                                                "false"
                                            )
                                        ) = "true",
                                        true,
                                        false
                                    ),
                                    recSubcontratTypeAfterDecisionYear: Lower(
                                        Switch(
                                            recTechnologyType,
                                            Technology.Wind,
                                            LookUp(
                                                recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                                category = "subcontract_type_after_decision_year"
                                            ).wind,
                                            Technology.PV,
                                            LookUp(
                                                recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                                category = "subcontract_type_after_decision_year"
                                            ).pv
                                        )
                                    ),
                                    recSubContractTypeDecisionYearUpDate: Date(
                                        Value(
                                            Switch(
                                                recTechnologyType,
                                                Technology.Wind,
                                                LookUp(
                                                    recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                                    category = "subcontract_type_decision_year_up"
                                                ).wind,
                                                Technology.PV,
                                                LookUp(
                                                    recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                                    category = "subcontract_type_decision_year_up"
                                                ).pv,
                                                Year(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)')
                                            )
                                        ),
                                        1,
                                        1
                                    ),
                                    recSubContractTypeReferenceDate: Switch(
                                        recTechnologyType,
                                        Technology.Wind,
                                        LookUp(
                                            recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                            category = "subcontract_type_reference_date"
                                        ).wind,
                                        Technology.PV,
                                        LookUp(
                                            recChangeRevenueTypeAssumptionRecords,
                                            category = "subcontract_type_reference_date"
                                        ).pv,
                                        "operationstartdatecod"
                                    )
                                },
                                With(
                                    {
                                        recSubContractChangeTypeDetail: If(
                                            recSubContractTypeDependingOnReferenceDate,
                                            Switch(
                                                recSubcontratTypeAfterDecisionYear,
                                                "fit",
                                                "FiT ",
                                                "cfd",
                                                "CfD ",
                                                "ppa",
                                                "PPA "
                                            ),
                                            Blank()
                                        ),
                                        recSubContractChangeActualDate: If(
                                            recSubContractTypeDependingOnReferenceDate,
                                            Switch(
                                                recSubContractTypeReferenceDate,
                                                "feasibilitystudies",
                                                gblRecordSelectedProject.'1-Feasibility studies',
                                                "projectdevelopmentstarted",
                                                gblRecordSelectedProject.'2-Project development started',
                                                "applicationsubmitted",
                                                gblRecordSelectedProject.'3-Application submitted',
                                                "legallybindingpermits",
                                                gblRecordSelectedProject.'4-Legally binding permits',
                                                "construction",
                                                gblRecordSelectedProject.'5-Construction',
                                                "finalinvestmentdecision",
                                                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Final Investment Decision',
                                                "operationstartdatecod",

                                        With(

                                                    recCountry = "France" && recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                                    "CfD ",
                                                    Text(recRevenueType) & " "

                                            },
                                            Concatenate(
                                                "Standard ",
                                                If(
                                                    Not(IsBlank(recRevenueType)),
                                                    If(
                                                        Not(recSubContractTypeDependingOnReferenceDate),
                                                        RevenueType,
                                                        If(
                                                            DateDiff(
                                                                recSubContractChangeActualDate,
                                                                recSubContractTypeDecisionYearUpDate,
                                                                TimeUnit.Days
                                                            ) < 0,
                                                            recSubContractChangeTypeDetail,
                                                            RevenueType

                                                    ),
                                                    Blank()
                                                ),
                                                If(
                                                    Not(IsBlank(recRevenueType)),
                                                    recCountry,
                                                    Blank()
                                                )
                                            )
                                        )
                                    )
                                )
                            ),
                            recRevenueCurrency: LookUp(
                                Currencies,
                                'Currency Code' = "EUR"
                            ),
                            recRevenueContractStartDate: DateAdd(
                                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
                                0,
                                TimeUnit.Days
                            ),
                            recRevenueContractDurationInYears: With(
                                {
                                    LookUpRecord: LookUp(
                                        recCountryAssumptions,
                                        And(valuetype = "contractdurationyear")
                                    )
                                },
                                If(
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                                    Value(LookUpRecord.pv),
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                                    Value(LookUpRecord.wind),
                                    Blank()
                                )
                            ),
                            recRevenueContractDurationInMonths: With(
                                {
                                    LookUpRecord: LookUp(
                                        recCountryAssumptions,
                                        And(valuetype = "contractdurationmonth")
                                    )
                                },
                                If(
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                                    Value(LookUpRecord.pv),
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                                    Value(LookUpRecord.wind),
                                    Blank()
                                )
                            ),
                            recRevenueCorrectionFactor: {
                                Value: 1,
                                StandardAssumptionValue: 1,
                                IsStandardAssumption: true
                            },
                            recRevenueContractHedgeVolume: With(
                                {
                                    LookUpRecord: LookUp(
                                        recCountryAssumptions,
                                        valuetype = "hedgedvolume"
                                    )
                                },
                                If(
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                                    Value(LookUpRecord.pv),
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                                    Value(LookUpRecord.wind),
                                    Blank()
                                )
                            ),
                            recRevenuePrice: With(
                                {
                                    recYear: Text(Year(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)')),
                                    recFilteredPrices: Filter(
                                        recCountryAssumptions,
                                        valuetype = "price"
                                    ),
                                    recPriceRecord: LookUp(
                                        Filter(
                                            recCountryAssumptions,
                                            valuetype = "price" && category = Text(Year(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)'))
                                        ),
                                        true
                                    )
                                },
                                If(
                                    !IsBlank(recPriceRecord),
                                    Switch(
                                        recTechnologyType,
                                        Technology.PV,
                                        Value(recPriceRecord.pv),
                                        Technology.Wind,
                                        Value(recPriceRecord.wind),
                                        Blank()
                                    ),
                                    Switch(
                                        recTechnologyType,
                                        Technology.PV,
                                        If(
                                            Value(recYear) < Value(First(recFilteredPrices).pv),
                                            Value(First(recFilteredPrices).pv),
                                            Value(recYear) > Value(Last(recFilteredPrices).pv),
                                            Value(Last(recFilteredPrices).pv),
                                            Value(
                                                First(
                                                    SortByColumns(
                                                        AddColumns(
                                                            recFilteredPrices,
                                                            Diff,
                                                            Abs(Value(ThisRecord.pv) - Value(recYear))
                                                        ),
                                                        "Diff",
                                                        SortOrder.Ascending,
                                                        "pv",
                                                        SortOrder.Descending
                                                    )
                                                ).pv
                                            )
                                        ),
                                        Technology.Wind,
                                        If(
                                            Value(recYear) < Value(First(recFilteredPrices).wind),
                                            Value(First(recFilteredPrices).wind),
                                            Value(recYear) > Value(Last(recFilteredPrices).wind),
                                            Value(Last(recFilteredPrices).wind),
                                            Value(
                                                First(
                                                    SortByColumns(
                                                        AddColumns(
                                                            recFilteredPrices,
                                                            Diff,
                                                            Abs(Value(ThisRecord.wind) - Value(recYear))
                                                        ),
                                                        "Diff",
                                                        SortOrder.Ascending,
                                                        "wind",
                                                        SortOrder.Descending
                                                    )
                                                ).wind
                                            )
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    )
                                )
                            ),
                            recFilteredInflationRecords: Filter(
                                recCountryAssumptions,
                                And(valuetype = "inflation")
                            )
                        },
                        With(
                            {
                                recRevenueInflationProfile: If(
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                                    If(
                                        LookUp(
                                            recFilteredInflationRecords,
                                            category = "useinflation"
                                        ).pv = "true",
                                        true,
                                        false
                                    ),
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                                    If(
                                        LookUp(
                                            recFilteredInflationRecords,
                                            category = "useinflation"
                                        ).wind = "true",
                                        true,
                                        false
                                    ),
                                    false
                                ),
                                recRevenueInflationCountryProfile: If(
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                                    If(
                                        LookUp(
                                            recFilteredInflationRecords,
                                            category = "usecountryinflation"
                                        ).pv = "true",
                                        true,
                                        false
                                    ),
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                                    If(
                                        LookUp(
                                            recFilteredInflationRecords,
                                            category = "usecountryinflation"
                                        ).wind = "true",
                                        true,
                                        false
                                    ),
                                    false
                                ),
                                recRevenueInflationCustomValue: If(
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                                    Value(
                                        LookUp(
                                            recFilteredInflationRecords,
                                            category = "inflationprofile"
                                        ).pv
                                    ),
                                    recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                                    Value(
                                        LookUp(
                                            recFilteredInflationRecords,
                                            category = "inflationprofile"
                                        ).wind
                                    ),
                                    0
                                ),
                                recRevenueInflationStartYear: With(
                                    {
                                        recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord: LookUp(
                                            recFilteredInflationRecords,
                                            category = "inflationstartyear"
                                        ),
                                        recOperationCODStartYear: Year(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)'),
                                        recFIDStartYear: Year(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Final Investment Decision'),
                                        recCluster5Year: Year(gblRecordSelectedProject.'5-Construction'),
                                        recCluster4Year: Year(gblRecordSelectedProject.'4-Legally binding permits')
                                    },
                                    If(
                                        Not(IsBlank(recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord)),
                                        If(
                                            recTechnologyType = Technology.PV,
                                            If(
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.pv = "operationstartdatecod",
                                                recOperationCODStartYear,
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.pv = "finalinvestmentdecision",
                                                recFIDStartYear,
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.pv = "construction",
                                                recCluster5Year,
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.pv = "legallybindingpermits",
                                                recCluster4Year
                                            ),
                                            recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind,
                                            If(
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.wind = "operationstartdatecod",
                                                recOperationCODStartYear,
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.wind = "finalinvestmentdecision",
                                                recFIDStartYear,
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.wind = "construction",
                                                recCluster5Year,
                                                recRevnueInflationStartYearRecord.wind = "legallybindingpermits",
                                                recCluster4Year
                                            ),
                                            Blank()
                                        ),
                                        Blank()
                                    )
                                )
                            },
                            Patch(
                                'Project Revenues',
                                Defaults('Project Revenues'),
                                {
                                    Project: gblRecordSelectedProject,
                                    Name: gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Name' & "-" & Text(recRevenueType) & "-" & recReveneDescription,
                                    Label: recRevenueType,
                                    Description: recReveneDescription,
                                    Currency: recRevenueCurrency,
                                    Subaccount: First(colRevenueSubaccounts),
                                    'Bidding Price': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology <> Technology.PV
                                        ),
                                        recRevenuePrice,
                                        0
                                    ),
                                    'Tariff / Price': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology <> Technology.PV
                                        ),
                                        recRevenuePrice * 1,
                                        recRevenuePrice
                                    ),
                                    'Tariff / Price p90': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind
                                        ),
                                        recRevenuePrice * 1,
                                        recRevenuePrice
                                    ),
                                    'Correction Factor': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology <> Technology.PV
                                        ),
                                        1.000,
                                        0
                                    ),
                                    'Contract Start Date': recRevenueContractStartDate,
                                    'Contract End Date': DateAdd(
                                        DateAdd(
                                            DateAdd(
                                                recRevenueContractStartDate,
                                                recRevenueContractDurationInYears,
                                                TimeUnit.Years
                                            ),
                                            recRevenueContractDurationInMonths,
                                            TimeUnit.Months
                                        ),
                                        -1,
                                        TimeUnit.Days
                                    ),
                                    'Correction Factor p90': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind
                                        ),
                                        1.000,
                                        0
                                    ),
                                    'Contract Duration Years': recRevenueContractDurationInYears,
                                    'Contract Duration Months': recRevenueContractDurationInMonths,
                                    'Use Inflation Profile': recRevenueInflationProfile,
                                    'Use Country Inflation Profile': recRevenueInflationCountryProfile,
                                    'Inflation Profile': recRevenueInflationCustomValue,
                                    'Hedged Volume': recRevenueContractHedgeVolume,
                                    'Inflation Start Year': Value(recRevenueInflationStartYear),
                                    'Owning Business Unit': gblRecordSelectedProject.'Besitzer (Unternehmenseinheit)',
                                    'Is Bidding Price Standard Assumption?': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology <> Technology.PV
                                        ),
                                        'Is Bidding Price Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.Yes,
                                        'Is Bidding Price Standard Assumption? (Project Revenues)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Is Contract Duration Years Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Contract Duration Months Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Contract Start Date Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Contract End Date Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Tarrif / Price Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Tarrif / Price P90 Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Use Inflation Profile Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Use Custom Inflation Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Inflation Profile Year Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Hedged Volume Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Custom Inflation Profile Standard Assumption?': true,
                                    'Is Correction Factor Standard Assumption': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Technology <> Technology.PV
                                        ),
                                        'Is Correction Factor Standard Assumption (Project Revenues)'.Yes,
                                        'Is Correction Factor Standard Assumption (Project Revenues)'.No
                                    ),
                                    'Is Correction Factor P90 Standard Assumption': If(
                                        And(
                                            gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Germany",
                                            recRevenueType = 'Revenue Labels'.FiT,
                                            recTechnologyType = Technology.Wind
                                        ),
                                        'Is Correction Factor P90 Standard Assumption (Project Revenues)'.Yes,
                                        'Is Correction Factor P90 Standard Assumption (Project Revenues)'.No
                                    ),
                                    NegativePriceManualOverride: 'NegativePriceManualOverride (Project Revenues)'.No
                                }
                            )
                        )
                    ),
                    false
                )
            )
        );
        ,
        true
    ),
    Notify(
        "Error: Project could not be saved. " & "Internal error: originated on " & FirstError.Source & ". Message: " & FirstError.Message & FirstError.Details.HttpResponse,
        NotificationType.Error
    )
);
UpdateContext(
    {
        locNeedShareholdingEntitiesUpdate: false,
        locNeedPlantCostsRecalculation: false,
        locGeneralDataIsSavingDialogVisible: false,

        locShareOfFarmdown: gblRecordSelectedProject.'Share of Farmdown',
